<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>东秦杀 · 复盘</title>
<style>
/* ================= 东秦杀：点名册 · 样式 v2 ================= */
:root{
  --bg:#0d1117;
  --bg2:#141b24;
  --panel:rgba(30,39,51,.82);
  --panel2:#26313f;
  --line:rgba(120,140,170,.22);
  --line2:rgba(140,165,200,.35);
  --text:#e9eef7;
  --dim:#93a3b8;
  --gold:#e8c46a;
  --gold2:#b8912f;
  --red:#e05a5a;
  --blue:#5aa8e0;
  --green:#5ac47e;
  --purple:#a97ae0;
  --orange:#e0894a;
  --card-w:82px;
  --card-h:118px;
  --shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;}
body{
  background:
    radial-gradient(1100px 620px at 50% -12%, #1d2a3a 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 100% 110%, #1a2230 0%, transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1117,#0b0f15 70%);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Hiragino Sans GB",system-ui,sans-serif;
  font-size:14px;overflow:hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body::before{ /* 细网格纹理 */
  content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.22;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(120,150,190,.07) 1px,transparent 1px),
                   linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(120,150,190,.07) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:34px 34px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#000 30%,transparent 85%);
}
button{
  font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2b3646,#212a37);
  border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:9px;padding:7px 13px;cursor:pointer;
  transition:.14s;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
button:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#37455a,#2a3546);border-color:#5d7a9c;transform:translateY(-1px);}
button:active{transform:translateY(0);}
button:disabled{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;}
button.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4d8fd0,#2f6497);border-color:#6aa8e0;}
button.primary:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5da0e0,#3873aa);}
button.big{padding:11px 26px;font-size:15px;border-radius:11px;}
button.mini{padding:4px 9px;font-size:12px;border-radius:7px;}
button.on{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3f6f9e,#2c5279);border-color:#6aa8e0;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(90,168,224,.3);}
button.skill{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#564a78,#3d3459);border-color:#8a72c0;}
button.skill:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#685a90,#4a3f6b);}

.screen{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;}
.screen.active{display:block;}

/* ---------------- 开始界面 ---------------- */
#screen-start{overflow:auto;}
.start-box{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:52px 24px 60px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.logo{font-size:52px;margin:0 0 8px;letter-spacing:8px;text-align:center;font-weight:900;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff3cf,#e8c46a 45%,#a97c22);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(232,196,106,.25));}
.logo span{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:4px;}
.slogan{color:var(--dim);text-align:center;margin:0 0 36px;line-height:1.8;}
.form-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.form-row>label{width:100px;flex:none;color:var(--dim);padding-top:8px;font-size:13px;}
.btn-group{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.identity-preview{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:5px;}
.id-chip{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);}
.id-chip.dean{background:rgba(160,70,70,.22);border-color:#8a4a4a;color:#f0b0b0;}
.id-chip.staff{background:rgba(70,120,160,.22);border-color:#4a7a8a;color:#a0d8e8;}
.id-chip.student{background:rgba(160,140,70,.2);border-color:#8a7a3a;color:#e8d090;}
.id-chip.mole{background:rgba(120,80,160,.22);border-color:#7a4a8a;color:#d0a0e8;}
.start-actions{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;margin-top:34px;}
.footnote{text-align:center;color:#5a6678;font-size:12px;margin-top:28px;}

/* ---------------- 选角界面 ---------------- */
#screen-role{overflow:auto;}
.role-box{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:44px 24px;text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.role-box h2{margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:4px;font-weight:800;}
.identity-card{display:inline-block;padding:12px 30px;border-radius:14px;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:12px;
  border:1px solid;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.identity-card.dean{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(150,60,60,.35),rgba(80,30,30,.5));border-color:#9a5a5a;}
.identity-card.staff{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(60,110,150,.35),rgba(30,60,90,.5));border-color:#4a7a8a;}
.identity-card.student{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(150,130,60,.3),rgba(80,70,30,.5));border-color:#8a7a3a;}
.identity-card.mole{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(110,70,150,.35),rgba(60,35,90,.5));border-color:#7a4a8a;}
.identity-card .big-word{font-size:24px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:8px;}
.identity-card .sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:5px;}
.hint{color:var(--dim);margin:8px 0 28px;}
.role-options{display:flex;gap:20px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.role-card{
  width:262px;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 16px 18px;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;text-align:left;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(44,54,68,.95),rgba(28,35,45,.95));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.role-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),transparent);opacity:.75;}
.role-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:var(--gold);
  box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(232,196,106,.35);}
.role-card .rc-name{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;}
.role-card .rc-title{font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);margin:4px 0 9px;}
.role-card .rc-hp{font-size:13px;color:var(--red);margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600;}
.role-card .rc-skill{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:7px;}
.role-card .rc-skill b{color:var(--blue);}

/* ---------------- 顶栏 ---------------- */
#screen-game{display:none;flex-direction:column;height:100%;}
#screen-game.active{display:flex;}
#topbar{
  flex:none;height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:0 16px;gap:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(22,30,40,.96),rgba(16,22,30,.96));
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4);z-index:20;
}
.topbar-left{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);flex-wrap:wrap;}
.tb-item b{color:var(--text);}
.tb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
#phase-label{padding:4px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;color:#cfe2f7;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#33455e,#26344a);border:1px solid var(--line2);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(90,168,224,.18);}
#my-id-banner{color:var(--dim);}
.bid{padding:2px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;}
.bid.dean{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7a3a3a,#5a2525);color:#ffc4c4;border:1px solid #a05a5a;}
.bid.staff{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2f5875,#1e3d55);color:#a8dcff;border:1px solid #4a7a9a;}
.bid.student{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6d5c2a,#4a3f1c);color:#f0dc9a;border:1px solid #8a7a3a;}
.bid.mole{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#573f75,#3a2850);color:#d9b6f5;border:1px solid #7a4a9a;}
.topbar-right{display:flex;gap:8px;flex:none;}

/* ---------------- 主棋盘 ---------------- */
#board{flex:1;display:flex;min-height:0;}
#opponents{
  flex:1;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;padding:12px;align-content:flex-start;
  justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
}
#sidebar{width:308px;flex:none;background:rgba(14,19,26,.75);border-left:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);}
#sidebar.hide{display:none;}
#sidebar-head{flex:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;}
#log{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7;}
#log div{margin-bottom:4px;color:var(--dim);border-left:2px solid rgba(120,140,170,.2);padding-left:9px;
  animation:logIn .18s ease;}
@keyframes logIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
#log div.hl{color:#eaf1fb;border-left-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(232,196,106,.06);}
#log div.dmg{color:#f3a8a8;border-left-color:var(--red);}
#log div.heal{color:#a6ecbe;border-left-color:var(--green);}
#log div.sys{color:#9cc4ee;border-left-color:var(--blue);}
#log div.big{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;border-left-color:var(--gold);
  background:rgba(232,196,106,.08);padding:4px 9px;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;}

/* ---------------- 座位圈（围圈坐） ---------------- */
#opponents{position:relative;}
.seat-ring{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;
  border:1px dashed rgba(140,170,210,.22);
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(90,140,200,.06),transparent 70%);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 60px rgba(90,140,200,.06);}
.seat-center{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;text-align:center;}
.seat-center span{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:6px;color:rgba(150,180,215,.45);}
.seat-center .sc-sub{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:1px;color:rgba(150,180,215,.3);}
.seat-you{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;
  font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--gold);
  background:rgba(232,196,106,.12);border:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.38);
  padding:3px 11px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(232,196,106,.18);}
.seated{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);top:0;left:0;}
.fallen-row{position:absolute;left:10px;top:8px;display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:flex-start;
  flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:42%;z-index:1;}
.fallen{transform:scale(.72);transform-origin:left bottom;
  position:relative;opacity:.34;filter:grayscale(.85);pointer-events:auto;}
/* 座位圈三档尺寸：按人数与可用空间自动选择，保证不重叠、不出界 */
#opponents.ring-compact{--card-w:66px;--card-h:96px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .player-panel{width:204px;padding:10px 11px 12px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .pp-avatar{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:15px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .pp-name{font-size:14px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .pp-title{font-size:10px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .pp-tag{font-size:10px;padding:1px 6px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .mini-card{width:34px;height:48px;}
#opponents.ring-compact .mini-card .m-name{font-size:7px;}

#opponents.ring-mini{--card-w:56px;--card-h:84px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .player-panel{width:170px;padding:8px 9px 10px;border-radius:13px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-avatar{width:28px;height:28px;font-size:13px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-name{font-size:12.5px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-title{font-size:9.5px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-seat{font-size:9px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-tag{font-size:9px;padding:0 5px;border-radius:6px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-hp{gap:2px;margin:6px 0 3px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .hp-pip{width:11px;height:8px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .gear-chip{font-size:9.5px;padding:1px 6px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .mini-card{width:28px;height:40px;}
#opponents.ring-mini .mini-card .m-name{display:none;}
#opponents.ring-mini .pp-judge-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;}

/* ---------------- 玩家面板 ---------------- */
.player-panel{
  width:238px;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 13px 14px;position:relative;transition:.18s;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,50,64,.92),rgba(26,33,43,.95));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;
}
.player-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(140,170,210,.5),transparent);}
.player-panel.turn{border-color:var(--gold);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(232,196,106,.5),0 0 26px rgba(232,196,106,.25),var(--shadow);}
.player-panel.turn::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);}
.player-panel.dead{opacity:.42;filter:grayscale(.75);}
.player-panel.targetable{cursor:pointer;}
.player-panel.selected{border-color:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(224,137,74,.5);}
.pp-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;}
.pp-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:19px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4a5f7a,#2b3a4d);box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.15);}
.pp-avatar.dean{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#a25050,#5e2a2a);}
.pp-avatar.staff{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3f7ba8,#234a68);}
.pp-avatar.student{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#a08c3f,#5e5122);}
.pp-avatar.mole{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#7b58a8,#412a5e);}
.pp-name{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;}
.pp-seat{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);}
.pp-title{font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);margin:2px 0 0;opacity:.9;}
.pp-id{font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;display:inline-block;font-weight:600;}
.pp-id.dean{background:rgba(160,70,70,.3);color:#f3b8b8;border:1px solid #8a4a4a;}
.pp-id.hidden{background:rgba(90,110,140,.2);color:#93a3b8;border:1px solid var(--line2);}
.pp-id.revealed-staff{background:rgba(60,120,160,.28);color:#a8dcff;border:1px solid #4a7a9a;}
.pp-id.revealed-student{background:rgba(150,130,60,.28);color:#f0dc9a;border:1px solid #8a7a3a;}
.pp-id.revealed-mole{background:rgba(120,80,160,.3);color:#d9b6f5;border:1px solid #7a4a9a;}
.pp-hp{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin:9px 0 5px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.hp-pip{width:15px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);transition:.2s;}
.hp-pip.on{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f07070,#b83a3a);border-color:#f0a0a0;
  box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(224,90,90,.5);}
.hp-pip.on.mole-hp{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b98ae8,#7a4ab0);border-color:#cfa8f0;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(169,122,224,.5);}
.hp-num{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-left:4px;}
.pp-row{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:5px;}
.pp-tag{padding:1px 7px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid var(--line);}
.pp-tag.warn{background:rgba(160,70,70,.24);border-color:#8a4a4a;color:#f0b0b0;}
.pp-tag.good{background:rgba(70,160,100,.22);border-color:#4a8a5a;color:#a0e0b0;}
.pp-gears,.pp-judge{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;}
.gear-chip{font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(80,110,150,.35),rgba(50,70,100,.35));
  border:1px solid rgba(120,160,200,.4);color:#c6dcf5;}
.gear-chip:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
.judge-chip{font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(130,90,180,.35),rgba(80,50,120,.35));
  border:1px solid rgba(160,110,210,.45);color:#e3c8f8;}
.judge-chip:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}

/* 通知栏：延时类事件牌以小卡形式贴在角色面板上 */
.pp-judge-wrap{margin-top:9px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed rgba(160,110,210,.32);}
.pp-judge-label{font-size:10px;color:#b48fe0;letter-spacing:2px;display:block;margin-bottom:6px;}
.pp-judge-cards{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.mini-card{width:40px;height:56px;border-radius:6px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;flex:none;
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,#f7f2e6,#ded4bf);border:1px solid #b9ae97;
  box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;}
.mini-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.07);}
.mini-card.red{color:#a4232a;}
.mini-card.black{color:#1d232c;}
.mini-card .m-rank{position:absolute;top:2px;left:4px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;}
.mini-card .m-suit{position:absolute;top:2px;right:4px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.2;}
.mini-card .m-name{position:absolute;bottom:3px;left:1px;right:1px;text-align:center;font-size:8px;
  line-height:1.15;color:#4a4238;letter-spacing:-.3px;}
.mini-card.next{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(180,120,230,.85),0 0 14px rgba(180,120,230,.5),0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  animation:judgePulse 2.1s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes judgePulse{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(180,120,230,.7),0 0 10px rgba(180,120,230,.4),0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(205,150,250,1),0 0 20px rgba(180,120,230,.75),0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}}
.pp-tag.dist{background:rgba(90,140,200,.22);border-color:rgba(120,170,230,.5);color:#b8d8f8;}
.pp-tag.out{background:rgba(120,120,140,.16);border-color:rgba(140,140,160,.38);color:#9aa3b2;}
.pp-handcount{position:absolute;right:13px;bottom:11px;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.25);padding:1px 7px;border-radius:8px;}
.pp-flag{position:absolute;right:10px;top:52px;font-size:11px;}
/* 电脑玩家思考中 */
.player-panel.thinking{border-color:rgba(120,170,230,.6);}
.player-panel.thinking::after{content:'思考中…';position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:8px;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:10px;pointer-events:none;
  color:#cfe0f5;background:rgba(90,140,200,.25);border:1px solid rgba(120,170,230,.5);
  animation:hintPulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;}

/* ---------------- 底部 ---------------- */
#bottom{flex:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(16,22,30,.92),rgba(12,17,23,.98));
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 16px 14px;}
#me-area{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:8px;}
#me-panel{width:252px;flex:none;}
#my-hand-wrap{flex:1;min-width:0;}
#my-hand{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:var(--card-h);align-items:flex-end;}
.hand-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:8px;min-height:17px;}
#actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;padding-top:8px;
  border-top:1px dashed rgba(120,140,170,.18);}

/* ---------------- 卡牌 ---------------- */
.card{
  width:var(--card-w);height:var(--card-h);border-radius:10px;flex:none;position:relative;
  cursor:pointer;transition:transform .14s,box-shadow .14s,filter .14s;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,#fbf7ec,#e6ddca);color:#241f1a;
  border:1px solid #cdc2a8;user-select:none;
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.7);
}
.card .c-band{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:22px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b4472f,#8c2f1e);}
.card.event .c-band{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3f6f9e,#2a4c73);}
.card.delayed .c-band{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6b4a9e,#452e70);}
.card.equip .c-band{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4a7f6a,#2c5443);}
/* 红/黑的第二通道：纹理。红 = 斜纹，黑 = 点阵。
   只靠颜色的话，红绿色盲玩家分不出"这张是不是红牌"，而判定、
   【学生证】（免疫黑色点名）这些都要用到红黑。纹理是冗余编码，不依赖色觉。 */
.card .c-rb{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:5px;border-radius:9px 0 0 9px;pointer-events:none;}
.card.red .c-rb{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(200deg,#c0392b 0 3px,rgba(192,57,43,.18) 3px 7px);}
.card.black .c-rb{background-image:radial-gradient(#243447 1.3px,transparent 1.4px);background-size:5px 5px;}
.mini-card::after,.exch-thumb::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;
  border-radius:6px 0 0 6px;pointer-events:none;}
.mini-card.red::after,.exch-thumb.red::after{
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(200deg,#c0392b 0 2px,rgba(192,57,43,.2) 2px 5px);}
.mini-card.black::after,.exch-thumb.black::after{
  background-image:radial-gradient(#243447 1px,transparent 1.1px);background-size:4px 4px;}

.card .c-corner{position:absolute;top:2px;left:7px;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;
  text-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.45);line-height:1.15;}
.card .c-corner .suit{font-size:13px;}
.card .c-corner.br{top:auto;left:auto;right:7px;bottom:3px;transform:rotate(180deg);
  color:rgba(70,60,50,.35);text-shadow:none;font-size:11px;}
.card .c-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;margin-top:30px;padding:0 4px;
  line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#2b241d;}
.card .c-desc{font-size:8.6px;color:#6f6656;text-align:center;margin-top:6px;padding:0 7px;
  line-height:1.4;overflow:hidden;max-height:34px;}
.card .c-tip{position:absolute;bottom:1px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:8px;
  color:rgba(90,80,70,.0);transition:.2s;}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-11px);z-index:6;
  box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(232,196,106,.55);}
.card:hover .c-tip{color:rgba(90,80,70,.5);}
.card.playable{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(232,196,106,.85),0 0 16px rgba(232,196,106,.4),0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  animation:cardPulse 1.9s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes cardPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(232,196,106,.85),0 0 14px rgba(232,196,106,.35),0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(232,196,106,1),0 0 22px rgba(232,196,106,.6),0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}}
.card.dim{filter:grayscale(.6) brightness(.72);}
.card.sel{transform:translateY(-16px);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--gold),0 14px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.55);}
.card.back{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3849,#1a222d);border-color:#3d4a5c;}
.card.big{width:152px;height:216px;border-radius:14px;}
.card.big .c-band{height:36px;}
.card.big .c-corner{font-size:22px;left:11px;top:4px;}
.card.big .c-corner .suit{font-size:20px;}
.card.big .c-name{font-size:19px;margin-top:50px;letter-spacing:2px;}
.card.big .c-desc{font-size:11px;margin-top:12px;max-height:70px;line-height:1.55;padding:0 12px;}
.card.big .c-corner.br{font-size:14px;right:11px;bottom:6px;}
.card.big .c-tip{display:none;}

/* ---------------- 弹窗 ---------------- */
#modal-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(5,8,12,.76);z-index:120;padding:20px;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);}
#modal-layer.show{display:flex;animation:fadeIn .16s ease;}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0;}to{opacity:1;}}
.modal{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(36,45,58,.98),rgba(24,31,41,.99));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:16px;max-width:min(1040px,94vw);max-height:88vh;
  overflow:auto;padding:20px 22px;min-width:360px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  animation:modalIn .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);}
@keyframes modalIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.modal h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:17px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:800;}
.modal .m-desc{color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7;}
.modal .m-body{margin-bottom:16px;}
.modal .m-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.modal .m-cards{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.modal .m-targets{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.target-pill{padding:8px 15px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.14s;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(48,60,76,.9),rgba(32,41,53,.9));border:1px solid var(--line2);}
.target-pill:hover{border-color:var(--green);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.target-pill.sel{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2f5840,#1e3b2a);border-color:var(--green);
  box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(90,196,126,.35);}

/* ---------------- 牌面 / 角色详情 ---------------- */
.dt-head{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
.dt-card{flex:none;}
.dt-meta{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.dt-line{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.dt-line.sub{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:400;color:var(--dim);margin-top:4px;display:block;}
.dt-suit{font-size:12px;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--line);}
.dt-suit.red{color:#f39a9a;border-color:#8a4a4a;background:rgba(160,70,70,.2);}
.dt-suit.black{color:#c8d2e0;border-color:var(--line2);}
.dt-suit.dean{color:#f3b8b8;border-color:#8a4a4a;background:rgba(160,70,70,.22);}
.dt-suit.staff{color:#a8dcff;border-color:#4a7a9a;background:rgba(60,120,160,.22);}
.dt-suit.student{color:#f0dc9a;border-color:#8a7a3a;background:rgba(150,130,60,.22);}
.dt-suit.mole{color:#d9b6f5;border-color:#7a4a9a;background:rgba(120,80,160,.24);}
.dt-avatar{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#4a5f7a,#2b3a4d);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45);}
.dt-avatar.dean{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#a25050,#5e2a2a);}
.dt-avatar.staff{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3f7ba8,#234a68);}
.dt-avatar.student{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#a08c3f,#5e5122);}
.dt-avatar.mole{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#7b58a8,#412a5e);}
.dt-avatar.unknown{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a4657,#232c38);color:#8fa0b5;}
.dt-sec{font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:2px;margin:16px 0 8px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.22);padding-bottom:5px;}
.dt-row{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(120,140,170,.14);font-size:13px;}
.dt-k{width:74px;flex:none;color:var(--dim);}
.dt-v{flex:1;line-height:1.65;}
.dt-skill{margin-bottom:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;}
.dt-skill-name{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:4px;}
.dt-type{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);margin-left:8px;font-weight:400;}
.dt-skill-text{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.7;color:#cfdae8;}

/* ---------------- 联机界面 ---------------- */
#screen-net{overflow:auto;}
.net-box{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:48px 24px 60px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.net-box h2{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:4px;margin:0 0 18px;font-weight:800;}
.net-box .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.9;margin:10px 0;}
.net-box .warn-hint{color:var(--orange);}
.net-box .btn-group{margin-bottom:6px;}

/* 房间号：等宽大字，方便照着念给同学听 */
.room-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:14px 0 4px;font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);}
.room-code-big{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;
  font-size:34px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:9px;color:var(--gold);
  text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(232,196,106,.28);}

.lobby-list{margin:14px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
.lobby-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 13px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(38,49,63,.7),rgba(28,36,48,.7));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;font-size:13.5px;}
.lobby-name{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
.lobby-tag{font-size:11.5px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;
  border:1px solid var(--line2);color:var(--dim);flex:none;}
.lobby-tag.seat{color:var(--blue);border-color:rgba(90,168,224,.5);}
.lobby-tag.host{color:var(--gold);border-color:rgba(232,196,106,.5);}
.lobby-tag.off{color:var(--red);border-color:rgba(224,90,90,.5);}

/* 输入框：整个项目原本一个都没有，这里补上 */
input[type=text]{font-family:inherit;font-size:14px;color:var(--text);
  background:rgba(10,14,20,.6);border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:9px;
  padding:9px 13px;width:100%;transition:.14s;outline:none;}
input[type=text]:focus{border-color:#6aa8e0;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(90,168,224,.3);}
input[type=text]::placeholder{color:#64748b;}
input.room-code{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,"Courier New",monospace;
  font-size:24px;letter-spacing:10px;text-align:center;padding:12px;}

/* ---------------- 结束界面 ---------------- */
#screen-over{overflow:auto;background:rgba(5,8,12,.94);}
.over-box{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 24px;text-align:center;position:relative;z-index:1;}
.over-box h2{font-size:38px;letter-spacing:6px;margin-bottom:22px;font-weight:900;}
#over-body{font-size:14px;line-height:2;color:var(--text);}
#over-body .ov-line{margin-bottom:5px;}
#over-body .ov-win{color:var(--green);font-weight:700;}
#over-body .ov-sec{margin:20px 0 9px;color:var(--dim);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:3px;}

/* ---- 赛后评分 / MVP ---- */
.ov-mvp{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:18px auto 4px;
  padding:12px 24px;border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(232,196,106,.16),rgba(40,32,14,.5));
  border:2px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(232,196,106,.25);}
.ov-mvp.me{box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(232,196,106,.5);}
.ov-mvp .mvp-badge{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:3px;color:#2a2008;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f0d089,#d8ac48);padding:3px 12px;border-radius:20px;}
.ov-mvp .mvp-who{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;color:#fff;}
.ov-mvp .mvp-score{font-size:15px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.ov-mvp .mvp-you{font-size:13px;color:var(--green);font-weight:700;}

.score-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin-top:4px;}
.score-table th,.score-table td{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px 8px;text-align:center;}
.score-table th{background:rgba(120,150,190,.1);color:var(--dim);font-weight:600;font-size:12px;}
.score-table td:nth-child(2),.score-table th:nth-child(2){text-align:left;}
.score-table tr.me{background:rgba(90,168,224,.09);}
.score-table tr.won td{color:#cfe8d8;}
.score-table tr.mvp{background:rgba(232,196,106,.14);}
.score-table tr.mvp td{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;}
.score-table td.sc{font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.score-table td .w{color:var(--green);font-weight:700;}
.score-table td.dean{color:var(--gold);} .score-table td.staff{color:var(--blue);}
.score-table td.mole{color:var(--purple);}
.score-note{margin-top:9px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.9;}

/* ---------------- Toast ---------------- */
#toast-layer{position:fixed;left:50%;top:70px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:200;pointer-events:none;}
.toast{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(28,36,48,.97),rgba(20,26,34,.97));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);
  padding:10px 18px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13.5px;
  animation:toastIn .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55);max-width:74vw;}
.toast.warn{border-left-color:var(--red);}
.toast.good{border-left-color:var(--green);}
@keyframes toastIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}

/* =========================================================
 *  特效层
 * ========================================================= */
#fx-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:130;}
.fx-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:92;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,rgba(6,10,16,.55),rgba(4,7,11,.82));
  animation:fadeIn .14s ease;}
.fx-overlay.out{animation:fadeOut .22s ease forwards;}
@keyframes fadeOut{to{opacity:0;}}
/* 点击继续：提示层可点击，游戏在此暂停等待确认 */
.fx-overlay.blocking{pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;}
.fx-advance-hint{margin-top:4px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;color:rgba(200,220,245,.75);
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:4px 16px;border-radius:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(140,170,210,.3);animation:hintPulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes hintPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.55;}50%{opacity:1;}}
.fx-play-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  animation:playIn .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3);}
@keyframes playIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px) scale(.86) rotate(-3deg);}
  to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.fx-play-caster{font-size:15px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:2px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);padding:4px 16px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--line);}
.fx-play-caster b{color:var(--gold);}
.fx-play-card{filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.75)) drop-shadow(0 0 26px rgba(232,196,106,.35));}
.fx-play-targets{font-size:15px;color:#ffd98a;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:700;
  text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8);min-height:20px;}

/* 中央结算卡：牌面 + 名称/点数 + 效果 + 作用对象 */
.fx-cardinfo{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;
  max-width:min(820px,94vw);padding:20px 26px;border-radius:18px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(34,43,56,.97),rgba(20,26,35,.98));
  border:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.35);
  box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 40px rgba(232,196,106,.12),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.04);}
.fx-info-col{flex:1;min-width:260px;max-width:430px;text-align:left;}
.fx-ci-name{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;color:#f4f8ff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.fx-ci-suit{font-size:14px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:10px;letter-spacing:0;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--line2);}
.fx-ci-suit.red{color:#ff9a9a;border-color:#8a4a4a;background:rgba(160,70,70,.22);}
.fx-ci-suit.black{color:#cfd8e6;border-color:var(--line2);}
.fx-ci-type{font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);opacity:.85;margin:5px 0 12px;letter-spacing:1px;}
.fx-ci-row{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.66;margin-bottom:7px;}
.fx-ci-row .k{flex:none;width:62px;color:var(--dim);}
.fx-ci-row .v{flex:1;color:#dde6f2;}
.fx-ci-row .v.hl{color:#ffd98a;font-weight:700;}
.fx-ci-row.lim .v{color:#93a3b8;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;}
/* ---------------- 新手教学提示卡 ----------------
   它原来是屏幕最顶上一条通栏细边 —— 太容易被当成装饰无视掉。
   现在是一张浮在手牌上方的大卡片：圆角、亮边、外发光、入场动画，外加一个「教学」角标。
   （字号/行高必须在 .tut-text 上重新写一遍：文件下方还有一条给引导弹窗用的
     .tut-text{font-size:13.5px;line-height:2}，那条会直接命中这里的 .tut-text。） */
#tutorial-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  /* 收窄居中：通栏的话文字和按钮之间会空出一大片，看着还是"一条"而不是"一张卡"。
     宽度和手牌区对齐（手牌也是居中排的）。 */
  max-width:860px;margin:0 auto 10px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#25455f,#16293b);
  border:1px solid rgba(126,198,255,.8);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(126,198,255,.14), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.55),
             0 0 28px rgba(90,168,224,.3);
  font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;color:#dce8f6;
  animation:tutIn .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.25);
}
#tutorial-bar.hide{display:none;}
@keyframes tutIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.97);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
#tutorial-bar .tut-badge{
  flex:none;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;
  color:#0d1a26;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#93d3ff,#4fa3dd);
  box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(120,190,255,.55);
}
#tutorial-bar .tut-icon{flex:none;font-size:20px;}
#tutorial-bar .tut-text{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;color:#dce8f6;}
#tutorial-bar .tut-text b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;}
#tutorial-bar .tut-actions{flex:none;display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto;}
#tutorial-bar button{flex:none;}
button.tut{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4a7f9e,#2c546f);border-color:#6aa8c8;}
button.tut:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a91b0,#356078);}

/* ---------------- 房主掉线条 ---------------- */
#host-gone-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:8px 14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2418,#2a1a12);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(224,137,74,.55);font-size:13px;z-index:6;}
#host-gone-bar.hide{display:none;}
#host-gone-bar .hg-text{color:#f0c9a8;flex:1;min-width:0;}

/* ---------------- 复盘回放条 ---------------- */
#replay-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding:7px 14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#2a1f3a,#1d1729);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(169,122,224,.45);font-size:12.5px;z-index:5;}
#replay-bar.hide{display:none;}
#replay-bar .rb-badge{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:20px;
  color:var(--purple);border:1px solid rgba(169,122,224,.55);flex:none;}
#replay-bar .rb-track{flex:1;min-width:120px;height:6px;border-radius:4px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);overflow:hidden;}
#replay-bar #rb-fill{height:100%;width:0;border-radius:4px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a97ae0,#6aa8e0);transition:width .12s linear;}
#replay-bar .rb-pos{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--dim);min-width:74px;text-align:right;}

/* ---------------- 弃牌堆查看 ---------------- */
.tb-item.clickable{cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;padding:2px 7px;transition:.14s;}
.tb-item.clickable:hover{background:rgba(120,150,190,.18);}
.discard-box{max-height:52vh;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;}
.discard-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;
  padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  border:1px solid var(--line);}
.discard-row .dr-name{font-weight:700;min-width:74px;}
.discard-row .dr-type{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);flex:none;}
.discard-row .dr-n{font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);min-width:30px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
.discard-row .dr-cards{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:.5px;
  flex:1;min-width:0;word-break:break-all;}

/* ---------------- 新手引导 ---------------- */
.tut-box{padding:4px 2px;}
.tut-step{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.tut-title{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--gold);}
.tut-text{font-size:13.5px;line-height:2;color:#cfdae8;}
.tut-text b{color:var(--text);}

/* ---------------- 身份轮抽（模式 B）---------------- */
#screen-draft{overflow:auto;}
#screen-draft .role-box{max-width:860px;}
.draft-card{cursor:pointer;}
.draft-card.dean{border-color:rgba(232,196,106,.6);}
.draft-card.dean .rc-name{color:var(--gold);}
.draft-card.mole{border-color:rgba(169,122,224,.55);}
.draft-card.mole .rc-name{color:var(--purple);}
.draft-card.staff{border-color:rgba(90,168,224,.5);}
.draft-card.student{border-color:var(--line2);}
.draft-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);}

/* 模式 C：选角色时还不知道身份 */
.identity-card.unknown{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(60,68,84,.9),rgba(34,40,52,.95));
  border-color:var(--line2);}
.identity-card.unknown .big-word{color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:6px;font-size:22px;}

/* 模式 C 的揭晓弹窗 */
.reveal-body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:6px 0 2px;}
.reveal-card{text-align:center;padding:22px 30px;border-radius:16px;min-width:230px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(44,54,70,.95),rgba(26,32,42,.98));
  border:2px solid var(--line2);box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  animation:revealPop .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.25);}
.reveal-card.dean{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(232,196,106,.35);}
.reveal-card.mole{border-color:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 44px rgba(169,122,224,.35);}
.reveal-card.staff{border-color:var(--blue);}
@keyframes revealPop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.86);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.reveal-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:2px;}
.reveal-big{font-size:36px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:8px;margin:8px 0 6px;}
.reveal-card.dean .reveal-big{color:var(--gold);}
.reveal-card.mole .reveal-big{color:var(--purple);}
.reveal-card.staff .reveal-big{color:var(--blue);}
.reveal-sub{font-size:13px;color:#cfdae8;}
.reveal-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.7;max-width:300px;}

/* =========================================================
 *  UI 改进：目标高亮 / 回合提示 / 思考读秒 / 环形座位 / 快捷语 等
 * ========================================================= */

/* ---- 当前回合更醒目 ---- */
.player-panel.turn{ animation:turnPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes turnPulse{
  0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(232,196,106,.5),0 0 18px rgba(232,196,106,.18),var(--shadow); }
  50%    { box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(232,196,106,.85),0 0 34px rgba(232,196,106,.42),var(--shadow); }
}
.pp-turn-ribbon{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:-11px;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;white-space:nowrap;
  padding:2px 12px;border-radius:20px;color:#2a2008;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f0d089,#d8ac48);
  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);pointer-events:none;
}

/* ---- 思考中读秒 ---- */
.pp-think{
  position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:8px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.5px;
  padding:2px 10px;border-radius:10px;pointer-events:none;
  color:#cfe0f5;background:rgba(90,140,200,.25);border:1px solid rgba(120,170,230,.5);
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.player-panel.thinking{ border-color:rgba(120,170,230,.6); }
.player-panel.thinking::after{ content:none; }   /* 字数交给 .pp-think 里的真实元素 */

/* ---- 选目标 ---- */
.player-panel.targetable{
  cursor:pointer;border-color:rgba(90,196,126,.65);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(90,196,126,.4),0 0 20px rgba(90,196,126,.2);
}
.player-panel.targetable:hover{ transform:translateY(-3px); }
.player-panel.selected{
  border-color:var(--orange);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(224,137,74,.7),0 0 26px rgba(224,137,74,.4);
}
#target-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin:0 14px 8px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(52,66,86,.95),rgba(34,44,58,.95));
  border:1px solid rgba(90,196,126,.5);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
#target-bar.hide{ display:none; }
#target-bar .tb-title{ font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text); }
#target-bar .tb-count{ font-size:12.5px;color:var(--dim); }
#target-bar .tb-count b{ font-size:15px;color:var(--red);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
#target-bar .tb-count b.ok{ color:var(--green); }
#target-bar .tb-names{ font-size:12.5px;color:var(--gold); }
#target-bar .tb-hint{ font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);flex:1;min-width:0; }
#target-bar .tb-actions{ display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto;flex-wrap:wrap; }

/* ---- 旁观席信息条 ---- */
#spectator-bar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin:0 14px 8px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,50,66,.9),rgba(26,33,43,.9));
  border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);
}
#spectator-bar.hide{ display:none; }
#spectator-bar .sp-badge{
  font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:20px;
  color:var(--gold);border:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.5);
}
#spectator-bar b{ color:var(--text); }
#spectator-bar .sp-hint{ margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;opacity:.8; }

/* ---- 手牌超限提醒 ---- */
.hand-warn{ color:var(--orange);font-weight:700;margin-left:10px; }

/* ---- 牌面类型角标（替代原来每张牌都印的"长按看详情"） ---- */
/* 贴在牌的底边（那里永远是空的）—— 原来放在描述文字高度上会压住说明 */
.c-type{
  position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:3px;
  font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:1px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:20px;
  color:rgba(240,246,255,.8);background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;
}
.card.equip .c-type{ color:#ffe6a8;border-color:rgba(232,196,106,.4); }
.card.event .c-type{ color:#c8b6f0;border-color:rgba(169,122,224,.45); }
.card.delayed .c-type{ color:#f0b6b6;border-color:rgba(224,90,90,.45); }

/* ---- 环形座位（围坐一圈） ---- */
#board-main{ position:relative; }
#opponents.ring{
  position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;
  display:block;padding:0;overflow:visible;background:none;
}
#opponents.ring .player-panel{
  position:absolute;width:238px;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
}
#opponents.ring.ring-compact .player-panel{ width:206px; }
#opponents.ring.ring-mini .player-panel{ width:172px; }
#opponents.ring.ring-mini .pp-title{ display:none; }
/* 中央留白：别让面板压住出牌区 */
#board-main.ring #play-area{ padding:15% 22%; }
#board-main.ring #play-stack{ max-height:100%; overflow:auto; }

/* ---- 快捷语 ---- */
.chat-bubble{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:-6px;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);
  max-width:230px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:12px;
  font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45;color:#1b2230;background:#e9eef7;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.15);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  animation:chatPop .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3);pointer-events:none;z-index:6;
}
.chat-bubble::after{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-6px;transform:translateX(-50%);
  border:6px solid transparent;border-top-color:#e9eef7;border-bottom:none;
}
@keyframes chatPop{ from{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-90%) scale(.9);} to{opacity:1;} }
.chat-box{ display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px; }
/* 聊天历史：聊天不进战斗日志，所以历史得自己有个地方待着 */
.chat-hist{max-height:32vh;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;
  padding:9px 11px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.22);border:1px solid var(--line);}
.chat-hist .ch-line{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#cfdae8;word-break:break-word;}
.chat-hist .ch-line b{color:var(--blue);}
.chat-hist .ch-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);text-align:center;padding:10px;}
.chat-presets{ display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px; }
.chat-free{ display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center; }
.chat-free input{ flex:1; }
#log .chat{ color:#cfe0f5; }
#log .chat::before{ content:"💬 "; }

/* ---- 邀请链接 ---- */
.invite-link{
  display:inline-block;margin-top:4px;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:8px;
  font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;
  color:var(--gold);background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.3);
  word-break:break-all;user-select:all;
}

@media (max-width:760px){
  .fx-cardinfo{padding:14px;gap:14px;}
  .fx-ci-name{font-size:19px;}
  .fx-info-col{min-width:0;}
}

/* 响应牌提示条 */
.fx-chip{position:fixed;left:50%;top:38%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:132;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;
  padding:11px 24px;border-radius:14px;font-size:15px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(36,46,60,.98),rgba(22,29,39,.98));
  border:1px solid rgba(120,170,230,.5);
  box-shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.7),0 0 26px rgba(90,168,224,.22);
  animation:chipIn .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3);}
.fx-chip.out{animation:chipOut .28s ease forwards;}
@keyframes chipIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.9);}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}}
@keyframes chipOut{to{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-62%) scale(.97);}}
.fx-chip b{color:var(--gold);font-size:16px;}
.fx-chip-card{padding:3px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;
  background:rgba(90,168,224,.18);border:1px solid rgba(120,170,230,.55);color:#cfe6ff;}
.fx-chip-card.red{background:rgba(196,80,80,.2);border-color:rgba(220,120,120,.6);color:#ffc8c8;}
.fx-chip-card.black{background:rgba(150,165,190,.16);border-color:rgba(170,185,210,.5);color:#dbe6f5;}
.fx-chip-note{color:#9fe0b8;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:1px;}

.fx-skill{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  font-size:16px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;color:#ffe9a8;white-space:nowrap;
  max-width:100%;text-align:center;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(232,196,106,.95),0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.95);
  animation:skillPop 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3) forwards;pointer-events:none;z-index:10;}
@keyframes skillPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6);}
  20%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.14);}
  35%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);}
  80%{opacity:1;}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.06);}}

.fx-turn{position:fixed;left:50%;top:70px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:95;
  padding:12px 34px;border-radius:16px;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,52,68,.97),rgba(24,31,41,.97));
  border:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.45);box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 30px rgba(232,196,106,.18);
  animation:turnIn .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.25);pointer-events:none;}
.fx-turn.out{animation:turnOut .3s ease forwards;}
@keyframes turnIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-22px) scale(.94);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%);}}
@keyframes turnOut{to{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-16px);}}
.fx-turn-name{color:var(--gold);font-size:21px;font-weight:900;}
.fx-turn-you{margin-left:14px;font-size:13px;color:#8fe0a8;letter-spacing:1px;}

.fx-float{position:absolute;left:50%;top:38%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:26px;font-weight:900;
  pointer-events:none;z-index:12;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.85);
  animation:floatUp 1.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1) forwards;white-space:nowrap;}
.fx-float.dmg{color:#ff7b7b;}
.fx-float.dmg.big{font-size:34px;color:#ff5a5a;}
.fx-float.heal{color:#7bf0a2;}
.fx-float.dodge{font-size:19px;color:#a8d8ff;}
.fx-float.draw{font-size:15px;color:#9fd0ff;}
@keyframes floatUp{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px) scale(.7);}
  20%{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px) scale(1.15);}
  40%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-10px) scale(1);}
  100%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-52px) scale(1);}}

.player-panel.fx-shake{animation:shake .42s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97);}
.player-panel.fx-shake-hard{animation:shakeHard .55s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(224,90,90,.6),0 0 26px rgba(224,90,90,.4);}
@keyframes shake{10%,90%{transform:translateX(-2px);}20%,80%{transform:translateX(3px);}
  30%,50%,70%{transform:translateX(-5px);}40%,60%{transform:translateX(5px);}}
@keyframes shakeHard{10%,90%{transform:translateX(-4px) rotate(-.6deg);}20%,80%{transform:translateX(6px) rotate(.6deg);}
  30%,50%,70%{transform:translateX(-9px) rotate(-.9deg);}40%,60%{transform:translateX(9px) rotate(.9deg);}}
/* 圆桌上的面板额外带 translate(-50%,-50%) 定位，震动需保持该位移 */
.seated.fx-shake{animation:shakeSeat .42s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97);}
@keyframes shakeSeat{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
  10%,90%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(-2px);}
  20%,80%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(3px);}
  30%,50%,70%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(-5px);}
  40%,60%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(5px);}}
.seated.fx-shake-hard{animation:shakeSeatHard .55s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97);}
@keyframes shakeSeatHard{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
  10%,90%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(-4px) rotate(-.6deg);}
  20%,80%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(6px) rotate(.6deg);}
  30%,50%,70%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(-9px) rotate(-.9deg);}
  40%,60%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(9px) rotate(.9deg);}}

.fx-info{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:110;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:20px;background:rgba(5,8,12,.72);pointer-events:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  animation:fadeIn .14s ease;}
.fx-info .modal{animation:modalIn .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);}

.fx-flash{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:88;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgba(224,90,90,.34),transparent 62%);
  animation:flashOut .55s ease forwards;}
.fx-flash.dark{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgba(20,0,30,.55),rgba(0,0,0,.8));}
@keyframes flashOut{from{opacity:1;}to{opacity:0;}}

.fx-judge-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  animation:playIn .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.3);}
.fx-judge-title{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:10px;color:var(--gold);opacity:.85;}
.fx-judge-src{font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);}
.fx-judge-card{width:104px;height:146px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:6px;font-size:44px;font-weight:900;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#fbf7ec,#e2d8c2);
  box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.7);animation:flipIn .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);}
.fx-judge-color{margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;font-weight:700;opacity:.85;}
.fx-judge-color.red{color:#ff9a9a;}
.fx-judge-color.black{color:#cfd8e6;}
.fx-judge-card.red{color:#b4232a;}
.fx-judge-card.black{color:#1d232c;}
.fx-judge-card .s{font-size:40px;}
@keyframes flipIn{from{transform:rotateY(90deg) scale(.8);opacity:0;}to{transform:none;opacity:1;}}
.fx-judge-name{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#e9eef7;font-weight:700;}

.fx-death-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;animation:playIn .4s ease;}
.fx-death-mark{font-size:64px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(224,90,90,.8));}
.fx-death-name{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:4px;color:#ffb0b0;}
.fx-death-id{font-size:15px;padding:6px 20px;border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:2px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--line2);}

/* 滚动条 */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:9px;height:9px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(120,140,170,.35);border-radius:5px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:rgba(140,165,200,.5);}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}

/* =========================================================
 *  v3 布局：横向座位队列（含你自己）+ 屏幕中央出牌区
 * ========================================================= */
#board{display:flex;flex-direction:row;flex:1;min-height:0;}
#board-main{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;min-height:0;}

#opponents{
  flex:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px 4px;
  justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;overflow:visible;
}
#opponents .player-panel{width:auto;flex:1 1 188px;min-width:172px;max-width:240px;}
.player-panel.is-me{border-color:rgba(232,196,106,.5);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(232,196,106,.25),var(--shadow);}
.player-panel.is-me::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold),transparent);}
.row-seat{position:relative;}

/* 中央出牌区：一次连锁中的所有牌都留在这里 */
#play-area{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:4px 14px 10px;min-height:0;}
#play-stack{width:min(780px,96%);max-height:100%;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
  padding:6px;border-radius:16px;transition:background .25s;}
#play-stack.active{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,rgba(90,140,200,.1),transparent 72%);}

.exch-card{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(34,43,56,.96),rgba(22,29,39,.97));
  border:1px solid rgba(232,196,106,.3);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  animation:exchIn .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2);}
@keyframes exchIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.94);}to{opacity:1;transform:none;}}
.exch-card.resp{margin-left:46px;padding:8px 12px;border-color:rgba(120,170,230,.45);}
.exch-thumb{width:54px;height:76px;border-radius:8px;flex:none;position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,#f7f2e6,#ded4bf);border:1px solid #b9ae97;
  box-shadow:0 3px 9px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
.exch-card.resp .exch-thumb{width:44px;height:62px;}
.exch-thumb.red{color:#a4232a;}
.exch-thumb.black{color:#1d232c;}
.exch-thumb.gray{color:#dbe6f5;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#5b6a80,#3a4657);border-color:#6b7a90;}
.exch-thumb .t-rank{position:absolute;top:3px;left:5px;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;}
.exch-thumb .t-suit{position:absolute;top:3px;right:5px;font-size:12px;}
.exch-card.resp .exch-thumb .t-rank{font-size:12px;}
.exch-card.resp .exch-thumb .t-suit{font-size:10px;}
.exch-thumb .t-name{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:2px;right:2px;text-align:center;
  font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.15;color:#4a4238;letter-spacing:-.3px;}
.exch-thumb.gray .t-name{color:#dbe6f5;}
.exch-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
.exch-head{font-size:13px;color:var(--dim);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.exch-head b{color:var(--gold);font-size:14px;}
.exch-name{color:#f2f7ff;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:1px;}
.exch-suit{font-size:12px;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:9px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--line2);}
.exch-suit.red{color:#ff9a9a;border-color:#8a4a4a;background:rgba(160,70,70,.22);}
.exch-suit.black{color:#cfd8e6;}
.exch-tag{font-size:11px;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:9px;color:#9fe0b8;
  background:rgba(70,160,100,.18);border:1px solid rgba(90,196,126,.4);}
.exch-line{font-size:12.5px;color:#cdd8e6;margin-top:5px;line-height:1.6;}
.exch-line.tgt{color:#ffd98a;font-weight:700;}
.exch-hint{align-self:center;position:sticky;bottom:0;}

/* 底部：只剩手牌与操作按钮 */
#bottom{display:block;}
#my-hand-wrap{width:100%;}
#my-hand{justify-content:center;}

@media (max-width:1000px){
  #sidebar{width:236px;}
  :root{--card-w:70px;--card-h:100px;}   /* 只影响手牌区；座位圈面板尺寸由三档布局控制 */
  .card .c-desc{display:none;}
}


</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app" class="">

  <!-- ============ 开始界面 ============ -->
  <div id="screen-start" class="screen">
    <div class="start-box">
      <h1 class="logo">东秦杀<span>：点名册</span></h1>
      <p class="slogan">早八、点名、代课、查寝、论文查重——在东秦大学，翻开身份牌之前，谁都不要信。</p>

      <div class="form-row">
        <label>玩家人数</label>
        <div class="btn-group" id="pick-count">
          <button data-count="4">4 人</button>
          <button data-count="5" class="on">5 人</button>
          <button data-count="6">6 人</button>
          <button data-count="7">7 人</button>
          <button data-count="8">8 人</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-row">
        <label>身份模式</label>
        <div class="btn-group" id="pick-mode">
          <button data-mode="A" class="on">A 随机身份</button>
          <button data-mode="B">B 自选阵营</button>
          <button data-mode="C">C 半随机</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-row">
        <label>你的选角候选</label>
        <div class="btn-group" id="pick-deal">
          <button data-deal="3" class="on">3 选 1</button>
          <button data-deal="5">5 选 1</button>
          <button data-deal="2">2 选 1</button>
          <button data-deal="8">8 选 1</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-row">
        <label>电脑强度</label>
        <div class="btn-group" id="pick-ai">
          <button data-ai="easy">简单</button>
          <button data-ai="normal" class="on">普通</button>
          <button data-ai="hard">困难</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p class="hint ai-hint" id="ai-hint">普通：电脑会做基本的身份推断，攻守均衡。</p>

      <div class="form-row">
        <label>可选规则</label>
        <div class="btn-group" id="pick-opt">
          <button data-opt="protect" class="toggle on">保护轮（第一圈不死）</button>
          <button data-opt="ai" class="toggle on">AI 接管其他玩家</button>
          <button data-opt="fast" class="toggle">快速动画</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-row">
        <label>身份配置预览</label>
        <div id="identity-preview" class="identity-preview"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="start-actions">
        <button id="btn-tutorial" class="tut big">新手教学局</button>
        <button id="btn-start" class="primary big">单机游戏</button>
        <button id="btn-net" class="big">联机对战</button>
        <button id="btn-rules" class="big">规则速查</button>
        <button id="btn-replay" class="big">看复盘</button>
        <input type="file" id="replay-file" accept=".json,application/json" hidden="">
      </div>
      <p class="footnote">所有角色、身份、事件均为虚构游戏设定，请勿对号入座。</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ 身份轮抽界面（模式 B 自选阵营）============ -->
  <div id="screen-draft" class="screen">
    <div class="role-box">
      <h2>选择你的身份</h2>
      <p class="hint">身份池是公开的，按座位顺序轮流挑；但<b>选完只有你自己知道</b>（院长公开）。</p>
      <div id="draft-note" class="hint deal-note"></div>
      <div id="draft-options" class="role-options"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ 选角界面 ============ -->
  <div id="screen-role" class="screen">
    <div class="role-box">
      <h2>选择你的角色</h2>
      <div id="my-identity-card" class="identity-card"></div>
      <p class="hint">角色只提供体力上限与技能，胜负由身份决定。</p>
      <div id="role-options" class="role-options"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ 游戏界面 ============ -->
  <div id="screen-game" class="screen active">
    <!-- 房主掉线提示条 -->
    <div id="host-gone-bar" class="hide">
      <span class="hg-text">房主掉线了，这局随时可能停摆</span>
      <button id="hg-take" class="mini">我来接手</button>
      <button id="hg-dismiss" class="mini">先不管</button>
    </div>
    <!-- 复盘回放条（只有回放时出现） -->
    <div id="replay-bar" class="hide">
      <span class="rb-badge">复盘回放</span>
      <button id="rb-toggle" class="mini">⏸ 暂停</button>
      <div class="rb-track"><div id="rb-fill"></div></div>
      <span id="rb-pos" class="rb-pos">0 / 0 帧</span>
      <button id="rb-s1" class="mini on">1×</button>
      <button id="rb-s2" class="mini">2×</button>
      <button id="rb-s4" class="mini">4×</button>
      <button id="rb-exit" class="mini">退出复盘</button>
    </div>
    <header id="topbar">
      <div class="topbar-left">
        <span class="tb-item" id="my-id-banner">你的身份：—</span>
        <span class="tb-item">牌堆 <b id="deck-count">0</b></span>
        <span class="tb-item clickable" id="tb-discard" title="点开看弃牌堆（数牌用）">弃牌 <b id="discard-count">0</b></span>
        <span class="tb-item">第 <b id="round-count">1</b> 轮</span>
        <span class="tb-item" id="phase-label">回合开始</span>
      </div>
      <div class="topbar-right">
        <button id="btn-chat" class="mini" title="快捷语（联机时全场可见）">💬</button>
        <button id="btn-layout" class="mini" title="座位排列方式">布局：队列</button>
        <button id="btn-advance" class="mini" title="中央出牌区何时清空">▶ 自动清空</button>
        <button id="btn-sound" class="mini" title="开关音效">🔊 音效</button>
        <button id="btn-speed" class="mini">节奏：标准</button>
        <button id="btn-log-toggle" class="mini">日志</button>
        <button id="btn-rule-panel" class="mini">规则</button>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main id="board">
      <div id="board-main">
        <!-- 横向座位排列（包含你自己） -->
        <section id="opponents"></section>
        <!-- 屏幕中央出牌区：一次结算连锁中的所有牌都留在这里，整条链结束后清空 -->
        <section id="play-area">
          <div id="play-stack"></div>
        </section>
      </div>
      <aside id="sidebar">
        <div id="sidebar-head">
          <span>战斗日志</span>
          <button id="btn-clear-log" class="mini">清空</button>
        </div>
        <div id="log"></div>
      </aside>
    </main>

    <footer id="bottom">
      <!-- 新手教学提示卡。
           放在**手牌正上方**、做成一张有边框和光晕的大卡片，而不是屏幕最顶上那条细边 ——
           细边太容易被无视，而新手这会儿眼睛正好在手牌这一带。
           #bottom 是 flex:none，所以卡片撑开时被压的是上面的棋盘，手牌不会被挤走。 -->
      <div id="tutorial-bar" class="hide">
        <span class="tut-badge">教学</span>
        <span class="tut-icon">💡</span>
        <span class="tut-text"></span>
        <span class="tut-actions">
          <button id="tut-next" class="mini">知道了</button>
          <button id="tut-exit" class="mini">退出教学</button>
        </span>
      </div>
      <!-- 选目标时的操作条（点棋盘选人，这里出「确定 / 取消 / 列表选择」） -->
      <div id="target-bar" class="hide"></div>
      <!-- 旁观席专用条 -->
      <div id="spectator-bar" class="hide"></div>
      <div id="my-hand-wrap">
        <div id="my-hand"></div>
        <div id="hand-hint" class="hand-hint"></div>
      </div>
      <div id="actions"></div>
    </footer>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ 联机界面（创建/加入/房间等待，内容由 js/net.js 动态生成）============ -->
  <div id="screen-net" class="screen">
    <div class="net-box" id="net-box"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ 弹窗层 ============ -->
  <div id="fx-layer"></div>
  <div id="modal-layer"></div>
  <div id="toast-layer"></div>

  <!-- ============ 结算 / 结束界面 ============ -->
  <div id="screen-over" class="screen">
    <div class="over-box">
      <h2 id="over-title">游戏结束</h2>
      <div id="over-body"></div>
      <div class="start-actions">
        <button id="btn-again" class="primary big">再来一局</button>
        <button id="btn-save-replay" class="big">保存复盘</button>
        <button id="btn-share-replay" class="big">导出分享版</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
